d: A nationwide flight disruption brought air travel across the United States to a halt after the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) experienced instability in radar and communication systems at air traffic control centres. US Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy said inconsistent radar data and communication with aircraft triggered a ground stop, forcing more than 3,500 aircraft that were in the air to land safely.
